configuration.name: dd_median3_paired_uniform128
configuration.time_sampler_note: Each adjacent pair has complementary times low=0.5u and high=1-low for u~U[0,1), with random assignment to its samples. The mixed marginal time distribution is uniform on [0,1] and every pair spans the two half-intervals.
configuration.train_notes: Official DD EMA initialization under dd-selfproto-v1.3. 128 targets, three proposals per original label, stable lower-median LPIPS-distance selection, one pass, uniform weights. Time pairs use complementary half-interval antithetic sampling. Frozen training and evaluation settings are supplied exclusively by the trainer.
